text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand images and videos. One important task is image recognition, which allows a computer to identify what is shown in a picture, such as a cat or a tree. Another key task is object detection, where the computer finds and locates multiple objects within an image. These technologies have many practical applications in our daily lives. For example, self-driving cars use computer vision to recognise traffic signs, detect pedestrians, and avoid accidents. Computer vision is also used in security cameras, medical imaging, and smartphones. As technology improves, computer vision will become even more common and useful in the future.
